selection_basis: Current official administration/configuration/new-feature/release-specific documentation corpus, followed by semantic comparison against the read-back 30-day inventory.

targets.topic: FortiOS 8.0 FortiGuard server preference, RTT-based selection and multi-server load balancing
targets.notes: Official indexed content includes CLI and GUI behavior; direct page open was 403.

targets.topic: FortiManager 8.0 local-user per-device mapping for branch-specific credentials and FortiToken bindings
targets.notes: New Features Guide links same topic in Administration Guide; direct page open restricted.

targets.topic: PostgreSQL-to-ClickHouse analytics migration, migration-state validation and archive-backed rebuild boundary
targets.notes: Release notes describe schema-upgrade then migration sequencing; CLI reference documents rebuild behavior.

targets.topic: FortiSwitchOS 8.0 DNS-over-TLS and explicit resolver CA validation
targets.notes: DoT TCP/853 and conditional CA validation are explicitly documented; cache-limit unit change is a release caveat.

targets.topic: Hotspot 2.0 WBA OpenRoaming ANQP advertisement and RADIUS WBA attributes
targets.notes: Configuration Guide provides end-to-end CLI and RADIUS packet verification.

targets.topic: FortiNAC 9.4 REST SMS Gateway request construction, HTTPS provider integration and visibility semantics
targets.notes: REST SMS Gateway was selected instead of Kerberos because the latter would overlap the recent FortiNAC-F Winbind/Kerberos lesson.

targets.topic: Persistent Agent certificate check: client proof, CA trust, CRL reachability and clock tolerance
targets.notes: Detailed certificate-check fields are exposed in 7.2.0 Windows reference; current 7.6.0 guide was cross-checked and version caveat is explicit.

targets.topic: FSSO Mobility Agent NTLM signing compatibility and endpoint-to-FortiAuthenticator identity transaction
targets.notes: Official admin guide page is indexed but direct open restricted; Community staff guide provides operational detail and is not treated as primary.

targets.topic: Associated-secret credential indirection and Smart Association username resolution
targets.notes: Official 1.9.0 Administration Guide documents Smart Association and Launch with semantics.

targets.topic: Bipartite user-workstation login anomaly detection and dynamic peer communities
targets.notes: Official guide documents graph, threshold, node-degree exclusion, training and inference.

targets.topic: EAP-TTLS LDAP authentication for IKEv2 IPsec agent tunnels
targets.notes: 7.4.0 guide documents LDAP and EAP-TTLS workflow; later SASE service versioning is distinct from FortiClient compatibility.

targets.topic: FortiOS 8.0 SD-WAN ISDB destination identity matching
targets.notes: Topic is narrowly the ISDB destination identity classifier, not the generic service-rule engine.

limitations: Some Fortinet Document Library pages returned HTTP 403; official search-indexed content and Fortinet-hosted PDFs were used.
Separate architecture guides were not present or required for every product; relevant administration/configuration/release-specific guides were checked.
FortiNAC-F certificate-check details are documented in a 7.2.0 Windows reference and cross-checked against current 7.6.0 Admin Guide.
